thread:
jordan.l: Postmortem follow-up: we still need final owners and deadlines for alert tuning tasks (dedupe, thresholds, paging policy). Keeping this thread to record commitments.

mei.z: I can own dedupe fingerprint changes and staging validation. I'll aim to open a small PR that replaces request_id in fingerprints with service:endpoint within 48h.

noah.b: I'll handle threshold retuning. Plan: produce per-endpoint p50/p95/p99 and propose new thresholds; I'll run a 60-day backtest.

clare.s: I'll take paging policy updates and run the 7-day pilot on one non-critical service. Will include escalation mapping and rollback steps.

alert-bot: Created task TASK-2026-8021 and linked to PMM-2026-1140. Notifications dispatched.

jordan.l: Please post one-line acceptance criteria + deadline. Want the postmortem closed by next Wednesday.

mei.z: Acceptance: dedupe reduces PD pages for rule WorkerError by >=70% in staging for 48h. Deadline: 2026-04-04.

noah.b: Acceptance: false positive rate <5% on backtest, no missed high-impact incidents. Deadline: 2026-04-03.

clare.s: Acceptance: pilot runs 7 days, documented sign-off by service owner, rollback exercised. Deadline: 2026-04-02.

jordan.l: Notes: avoid dropping tenant_id or region in dedupe rules. Noah, add backtest queries to your PR. Clare, tag the pilot owner in the doc.

mei.z: Example change I'll test:
```yaml
- alert: WorkerErrorBurst
  expr: increase(worker_errors_total[5m]) > 100
  labels:
    dedupe_fingerprint: "{{ service }}:{{ endpoint }}:{{ error_code }}"
```
This groups similar errors while preserving tenant/region labels.

noah.b: Will post histograms and the backtest CSV later today.

clare.s: Drafting pilot checklist now, will link it here when ready.

jordan.l: I'll create the follow-up issue and schedule a 10m check-in Mon 10:00. Thanks all. Closing thread; add PR links here as they appear. :thumbsup:
